_comment: Per-job profile + interference model. solo_runtime_1t_s recalibrated 2026-05-10 from measured per-job runtimes (results.json from hand-crafted Part 3.1 run). Backed-out formula: solo_1t = measured × scaling[deployed_threads]. p95 baseline calibrated from mcperf_1.txt. Memcached additive impacts are still rough estimates — they need a co-located mcperf run to refine. 8t scaling values for canneal/streamcluster should be re-derived from measured 8t runtimes if available.

freqmine._calibration: measured 87s at 6t on node-a (sharing with memcached + bs/vips). solo_1t = 87 * 4.6 = 400.2

blackscholes._calibration: measured 39s at 4t on node-a (parallel with vips). solo_1t = 39 * 3.7 = 144.3

vips._calibration: measured 50s at 2t on node-a (parallel with bs). solo_1t = 50 * 1.9 = 95.0

barnes._calibration: measured 42s at 4t on node-a (after bs+vips, solo on node-a apart from memcached). solo_1t = 42 * 3.4 = 142.8

canneal._calibration: measured 81s at 4t on node-b (solo, no memcached neighbor). solo_1t = 81 * 2.9 = 234.9. UPDATE scaling[8] from your measured 8t runtime: scaling[8] = 2.9 * (81 / measured_8t).

streamcluster._calibration: measured 149s at 4t on node-b (solo after canneal). solo_1t = 149 * 3.3 = 491.7. UPDATE scaling[8] from your measured 8t runtime: scaling[8] = 3.3 * (149 / measured_8t).

radix._calibration: measured 12s at 4t on node-a (solo after barnes). solo_1t = 12 * 3.6 = 43.2
radix._requires_node_a_reason: splash2x-radix native input > 3.6 GB; OOMs on node-b

interference._comment: Multiplicative slowdown applied to every job sharing a node. Looked up by the qualitative class pair of the two jobs. Symmetric. Disjoint-cores penalty; oversubscription is handled separately in engine.py.

memcached_share_node_slowdown._comment: Extra slowdown on a PARSEC job for sharing node-a with memcached, by job's own mem_bw class.

interference._oversubscription_comment: Per-thread efficiency drop when total threads on a core-set exceed the core count. extension *= (total_threads / cores) ** (1 - 0.85) clipped at 2.0.
